2116638073102708790.en_summary: $META, $GOOGL and $AMZN are all below both the 50dma and 200dma. Buying these quality names below major moving averages has historically rewarded investors in the next few months, unless a deeper 2022-type bear market drawdown is expected.
2116638073102708790.zh_summary: $META、$GOOGL 與 $AMZN 均低於 50 日與 200 日移動平均線。除非預期出現更深層的 2022 年式熊市回撤，否則在主要移動平均線以下買入這些優質股票，歷史上於未來數月通常獲得回報。

2116636345426903102.en_summary: $GOOGL Google Cloud CEO: TPU system sales could reduce Alphabet's direct infrastructure requirements by shifting data center investment toward customers and partners. Placing TPU systems in third-party facilities and customer data centers broadens the addressable market and offsets the need to prebuild facilities.
2116636345426903102.zh_summary: $GOOGL Google Cloud 行政總裁指出，TPU 系統銷售可將資料中心投資轉移至客戶與合作夥伴，從而減少 Alphabet 直接基建需求。將 TPU 系統置於第三方設施與客戶資料中心，可擴大可服務市場，並抵消預先興建設施的需要。

2116634941723378068.en_summary: (Reposted content) Elon leaves no man behind by merging Twitter co-investors into xAI at high valuation, xAI into SpaceX, discussing Tesla into SpaceX, and working to save $SPCX investors with claims of 100,000 satellites, 20 GW power and cooling, nationwide DTC service, and $1T run-rate revenue in 15 months, resulting in only a 6% stock pop while lockups allow unloading.
2116634941723378068.zh_summary: （轉貼內容）Elon 透過以高估值將 Twitter 共同投資者併入 xAI、xAI 併入 SpaceX、討論將 Tesla 併入 SpaceX，並以 10 萬顆衛星、20 GW 電力與冷卻、全國 DTC 服務及 15 個月內 1 萬億美元營收運行率等聲稱拯救 $SPCX 投資者，最終僅帶來 6% 股價上升，同時鎖定期解除後可繼續出貨。

ticker_notes.SPCX: 僅 6% 升幅，鎖定期後可出貨

2116631643968643484.en_summary: Andy Jassy saying Amazon will have two $1T businesses in next 5-10 years looks doable based on e-comm at $600B (80% of retail still physical) and AWS at $140B+ (85% of IT spend still on-prem). Quoted: no trillion-dollar revenue business yet, may have two in 5-10 years.
2116631643968643484.zh_summary: Andy Jassy 稱亞馬遜未來 5 至 10 年將有兩項 1 萬億美元業務，根據電子商務達 6000 億美元（零售 80% 仍為實體）及 AWS 達 1400 億美元以上（IT 支出 85% 仍為本地部署）來看可行。引述：尚未有萬億美元營收業務，未來 5 至 10 年可能有兩項。

2116629516907114810.en_summary: Elon Musk says there will be a total of around 1.2M $NVDA Blackwells at Colossus 2 by end of year. That includes 200K GB300s dedicated to inference with less than half the fiber of training clusters as $SPCX says new compute is paying back in under a year.
2116629516907114810.zh_summary: Elon Musk 稱 Colossus 2 年底將有約 120 萬個 $NVDA Blackwell。其中包括 20 萬個專用於推理的 GB300，光纖用量少於訓練集群一半，$SPCX 稱新算力回收期不到一年。

ticker_notes.SPCX: 新算力回收期不到一年
